description: Typing '/' in the input shows nothing. The Input component has a full autocomplete system (autocomplete_provider, suggestions, navigation keys) and Autocomplete.builtin_commands/0 lists /help, /clear, /compact, /cost, /model, /theme, /config. But input.autocomplete_provider is never set during startup in do_run/1 — it remains nil, and refresh_autocomplete returns early.\n\nNeeds: create a slash-command autocomplete provider during startup that combines builtin_commands() with loaded prompt templates, and assign it to input.autocomplete_provider.
title: Slash command autocomplete not wired in — no dropdown on /
